pages.title: An Offering First
pages.text: Deep One relations provide an alternative to constant fighting.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Pearls can come from mussels grown on logs. Ordinary Deep Ones, knights and mages share reputation but different loot: knight Ortholance/Conch, mage Sea Staff. Do not attack trading partners.

pages.title: Practical note

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Transfer water with a redstone Drain and ascend with a Floater. The Drain needs liquid above and empty space below. Gossamer Worm Bioluminessence makes Floaters, underwater torches and Glowing potions. Light and glowing creatures attract Hullbreakers.
